'''Aurel Voss''' (7 December 1845, [[Altona, Hamburg|Altona]], Germany – 19 April 1931, [[Munich]], Germany) was a German [[mathematician]], best known today for his contributions to [[geometry]] and [[mechanics]].<ref>[https://www.lagis-hessen.de/pnd/11745057X A short biography of Aurel Voss] in ''Hessische Biografie''.</ref><ref>{{Citation
|author-first=Hans-Joachim
|author-last=Vollrath
|author-link =
|title = Über die Berufung von Aurel Voss auf den Lehrstuhl für Mathematik in Würzburg
|trans-title= About the appointment of Aurel Voss to the chair of mathematics in [[Würzburg]]
|journal =Würzburger medizinhistorische Mitteilungen
|volume =11
|issue=
|pages =133–151
|year =1993
|language =German
|url =
|doi =
|pmid=11639870
|jfm = 
}}
</ref> He served as president of the [[German Mathematical Society]] for the 1898 term.
He was a professor at the [[Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München]] from 1902 until 1923. He became [[Emeritus]] in 1923.

In 1880, Voss published a version of the [[contracted Bianchi identities]].<ref name="voss" >{{citation|title=Zur Theorie der Transformation quadratischer Differentialausdrücke und der Krümmung höherer Mannigfaltigketien |last=Voss|first=A.|author-link=Aurel Voss|journal=Mathematische Annalen|volume=16|pages=129–178|year=1880|issue=2 |language = German|url=https://zenodo.org/record/2440927|doi=10.1007/bf01446384|s2cid=122828265}}</ref><ref>{{Citation

== Career ==
=== Education === 
Voss studied [[Mathematics]] and [[Physics]] at the [[University of Hannover]], the [[University of Göttingen]], and [[Heidelberg University]] between 1864 and 1868.

He received a [[PhD]] from the [[University of Göttingen]] the following year.

== Honors ==
He was awarded an [[Honorary Doctorate]] in Engineering Sciences by [[TH Munich]] in 1915.
